en.title: Tide of the Singularity
en.premise: Nomad, a solitary planet without a star, survives solely on the Hawking radiation emitted by a central micro‑black hole, sustaining a bizarre ecosystem. An expedition crosses the planet’s surface—vast crystal forests that resemble icy castles—and descends into the abyssal depths to the ruins of an ultra‑ancient civilization. Their goal: to retrieve the “Quantum Information Archive,” a key that might avert the universe’s heat death.

zh.title: 特异点的潮汐
zh.premise: 没有恒星的孤独星球Nomad。这里唯一的热源是位于中心的微型黑洞所释放的霍金辐射，维系着奇异的生态系统。调查队穿越如冰之城堡般的巨大晶体群，深入深海，抵达沉没的超古代文明遗迹。他们寻找的，是能够避免宇宙热寂的“量子信息档案”。
